items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern vector redraw, not an artifact date
items.tradition: Small seal script (file description label: Shuowen seal script style)
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 先 in Shuowen seal-script style; compare its later dictionary form with the reported early person-and-foot interpretation.
items.alt: A single seal-script style glyph labeled 先.
items.selection_reason: It provides a labeled later-form comparison and has an inspected Commons description page with an original-file link and reuse terms. It does not independently demonstrate Shang graphic continuity.
items.rights: Public domain; attribution is not required but appreciated, according to the exact Commons file description.

limitations.text: No eligible early-script image was selected: the oracle-style candidates named in the acquisition failure record returned HTTP 404 and are unavailable for this run. The selected seal-style candidate is a modern redraw and its pixels could not be opened here, so it cannot serve as an image of a Shang artifact or verify the proposed early component shapes.
